name: IBM Products Multiple Vulnerabilities
description:
Multiple vulnerabilities have been identified in the multiple IBM products, leading to XSS, information disclosure, and spoofing attacks.

How it can be Exploited
CVE-2022-22365: IBM WebSphere Application Server, with the Ajax Proxy Web Application (AjaxProxy.war) deployed, is vulnerable to spoofing.

CVE-2021-39043: The cross-site scripting vulnerability exists in IBM Jazz Team Server which could allow hackers to embed arbitrary JavaScript code in the Web UI.

CVE-2020-4970: The information disclosure vulnerability exists in IBM Security Identity Governance and Intelligence because failure occurs while properly enabling HTTP Strict Transport Security.
